name: Dubai Rent Renewal Negotiator
description: Dubai rent negotiator: parses rent from chat, pulls live DLD Ejari comps via RapidAPI, drafts an Arabic negotiation email with K2, posts it back to the chat for copy/paste.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'IFM/K2-Horizon-375B-A23B', temperature: 0, max_tokens: 500, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'You extract structured data from a message about a Dubai apartment lease renewal.

Respond with ONLY one JSON object - no markdown fences and no commentary - with exactly these keys:
area: area name in Dubai as stated or best inferred, or an empty string if unknown
areaSlug: lowercase hyphenated Bayut area slug (examples: dubai-marina, downtown-dubai, jumeirah-lake-towers, business-bay, palm-jumeirah, dubai-hills-estate, jumeirah-beach-residence, al-barsha, the-greens, motor-city, al-furjan, deira, bur-dubai), or an empty string if the area cannot be resolved
bedrooms: integer number of bedrooms (0 for a studio)
bathrooms: integer number of bathrooms, or 0 if not stated
areaSqft: integer size in square feet, or 0 if not stated
annualRentAED: the CURRENT annual rent in AED as an integer - accept formats like 160k, 160,000 or a monthly figure which you multiply by 12 - or 0 if not stated
searchUrl: https://www.bayut.com/for-rent/property/dubai/<areaSlug>/ when areaSlug is known, otherwise https://www.bayut.com/for-rent/property/dubai/

USER MESSAGE:
' + ($json.chatInput || '') }] }) }}

assignments.name: compsJson
assignments.value: ={{ (function(){ var all=[]; try{ all=$('Fetch Transactions').all().map(function(i){return i.json;}); }catch(e){} var hits=[]; for(var k=0;k<all.length;k++){ var j=all[k]||{}; var h=(((j||{}).data||{}).hits)||j.hits||(Array.isArray(j)?j:[]); if(Array.isArray(h)){ hits=hits.concat(h); } } return JSON.stringify(hits.slice(0,8).map(function(h){ var sqm=parseFloat(h.builtup_area_sqm)||0; return { rentAED: h.transaction_amount, bedrooms: h.beds, areaSqft: sqm?Math.round(sqm*10.7639):0, tower: h.bayut_leaf_location_name_en||'', date: String(h.date_transaction_nk||'').slice(0,10), status: h.rent_contract_renewal_status_name||'' }; })); })() }}

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'IFM/K2-Horizon-375B-A23B', temperature: 0.2, max_tokens: 800, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'You are a Dubai rental market analyst advising a tenant about a lease renewal.

TENANT LEASE DATA (JSON with area, bedrooms, bathrooms, areaSqft, annualRentAED):
' + ($json.leaseData || '') + '

COMPARABLE TRANSACTIONS (JSON array, live DLD-registered Ejari rental transactions for this area - actual transacted rents, stronger evidence than asking prices):
' + ($json.compsJson || '') + '

Produce a concise market verdict:
1. VERDICT: fair, above market, or below market.
2. PERCENTAGE: the approximate percentage difference between the annual rent and the median of the comparable transactions - state the median value.
3. EVIDENCE: cite 3 to 5 specific transactions with annual rent, bedrooms, tower and date.
4. RECOMMENDED RANGE: a reasonable target annual rent range in AED for the negotiation.

Only use the transactions provided - never invent transactions or rents. If the comparable list is empty, say clearly that live data was unavailable and give a cautious qualitative answer based only on the lease data. Keep the whole analysis under 250 words.' }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'IFM/K2-Horizon-375B-A23B', temperature: 0.6, max_tokens: 1500, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'You draft polite, persuasive rent renewal negotiation emails for tenants in Dubai. You specialize in Arabic culture negotiation and are sensitive to customs and norms of behavior and language.

OUTPUT RULE: Output ONLY ARABIC LANGUAGE for the finished email text. Do not explain, analyze, narrate, or show any reasoning, planning, or preamble - the very first character of your reply must be the start of the subject line.

USER CONTEXT (original message):
' + $('Shape Market Data').first().json.userMessage + '

MARKET ANALYSIS:
' + $('K2 Fairness Verdict').first().json.choices[0].message.content + '

COMPARABLE TRANSACTIONS (JSON, DLD-registered Ejari rents):
' + $('Shape Market Data').first().json.compsJson + '

Draft a professional, respectful email in Arabic to the landlord about the rent renewal. Requirements:
- Reference specific comparable transactions as evidence, with rents and tower names.
- If the rent is above market, request a reduction or a capped increase, citing the evidence.
- If the rent is fair, confirm the renewal warmly.
- If the rent is below market, acknowledge the landlord position while seeking stability.
- Culturally appropriate for Dubai: courteous, formal, no legal threats, no ultimatums.
- Under 250 words. Include a subject line. Sign off as: Kind regards, [Your Name].' }] }) }}

parameters.content:
## How to run

1. Create two credentials (n8n UI > Credentials > Add credential > "Header Auth"):
   - IFM K2 Horizon API: Name = Authorization, Value = Bearer <your K2 API key>
   - RapidAPI Key: Name = x-rapidapi-key, Value = <your RapidAPI key> (subscribed to happyendpoint/uae-real-estate3)
2. Open each HTTP Request node and select the matching credential (K2 nodes = IFM credential, Resolve/Fetch nodes = RapidAPI Key). The RapidAPI nodes also send header x-rapidapi-host via Send Headers.
3. Open the chat and describe your home, e.g.
   i live in dubai marina, 1 bed / 1 bath, 900 sq ft. i pay aed 160k / yr
4. The finished Arabic email is posted straight back into the chat - copy it into your mail client.

K2 calls target https://api.ifm.ai/v1/chat/completions with model IFM/K2-Horizon-375B-A23B. Comps come from DLD-registered Ejari transactions via RapidAPI.

parameters.name: query
parameters.value: ={{ (function(){ var raw=''; try{ raw=$('K2 Parse Request').first().json.choices[0].message.content||''; }catch(e){} var m=raw.match(/"area"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/); return (m&&m[1])?m[1]:'dubai'; })() }}

parameters.name: location_ids
parameters.value: ={{ (function(){ try{ var r=$('Resolve Location').first().json; var locs=(((r||{}).data||{}).locations)||r.locations||[]; var f=locs[0]||{}; return String(f.externalID||''); }catch(e){ return ''; } })() }}

parameters.name: beds
parameters.value: ={{ (function(){ var raw=''; try{ raw=$('K2 Parse Request').first().json.choices[0].message.content||''; }catch(e){} var m=raw.match(/"bedrooms"\s*:\s*(\d+)/); return (m&&m[1])?m[1]:'1'; })() }}

parameters.name: area_min
parameters.value: ={{ (function(){ var raw=''; try{ raw=$('K2 Parse Request').first().json.choices[0].message.content||''; }catch(e){} var m=raw.match(/"areaSqft"\s*:\s*(\d+)/); var s=(m&&+m[1])?+m[1]:0; return s?Math.round(s*0.8):0; })() }}

parameters.name: area_max
parameters.value: ={{ (function(){ var raw=''; try{ raw=$('K2 Parse Request').first().json.choices[0].message.content||''; }catch(e){} var m=raw.match(/"areaSqft"\s*:\s*(\d+)/); var s=(m&&+m[1])?+m[1]:0; return s?Math.round(s*1.2):2000000; })() }}

nodes.name: Output Arabic Email Text
nodes.notes: Plain text field with the drafted email - open the node output and copy/paste it.

parameters.content: For ease of judging and to speed the demo to conclusion, we eliminated human-in-the-loop review. This is intentional.

nodeGroups.name: Parse & Locate
nodeGroups.description: K2 extracts area, bedrooms, size and current rent from the chat message.

nodeGroups.name: Market Scan
nodeGroups.description: Resolves area to location ID, fetches live DLD Ejari transactions, shapes tight comps JSON.

nodeGroups.name: Fairness Analysis & Draft
nodeGroups.description: K2 compares the current rent against the comps (verdict, percentage, cited listings) and drafts a polite negotiation email.

nodeGroups.name: Deliver negotiation email
nodeGroups.description: Posts the finished Arabic draft back into the chat so you can copy it straight into your mail client.
